current.changeLog:
Improvements
1. You can now decide whether to ignore the unique voiceovers of special crew members.
A new option, “GuP Voice Selector: Ignore the voices of special crews”, has been added at the bottom of Settings → Sound.
This option works as follows:
When enabled: The voiceover selected in the GuP Voice Selector will always be used in battle, regardless of which crew members are assigned to the vehicle, including official Girls und Panzer collaboration crew members. The original unique voiceovers of all special crew members will be ignored.
When disabled: Crew members with their own unique voiceovers will continue to use their original voiceovers, and the voiceover selected in the GuP Voice Selector will be ignored for those crew members.
2. Added a Chinese version of the Girls und Panzer subtitles.
You can choose either subtitle version according to your preference, or install neither if you do not need subtitles.

current.changeLog:
v7.3.0 - six new languages + WoT 2.4.0.0.

NEW: French, Spanish, German, Czech, Italian and Portuguese. SpotMeter now speaks eight languages (EN / PL / FR / ES / DE / CS / IT / PT) across the in-battle panel and every label and hover tooltip in the settings menu, using the game's own terminology. Pick one in the settings menu, or set "language" in spotmeter.json; "auto" follows your WoT client and now matches on the language-code prefix, so regional variants get their own language instead of English.

Fixed: the settings menu now keeps the language you picked after you close the window, and the battle panel's footer is translated instead of always showing Polish.

Rebuilt for WoT 2.4.0.0 the spot-distance engine, circle and panel are unchanged.
